active: Props are balanced. Don't make me redo them.
Battery's fresh. Bring it back that way.
injured: Stitched up and still turning wrenches. Go.
Bring it back in one piece. Unlike me.

active.text: Pays enough to cover the props you'll break. Probably.
Drone's ready. Don't ask about the van.
Take it. I need parts money.

injured.text: Take it. I'll fix the drone one-handed.
I'm stitched up and it still pays. Go.
Bring the drone back whole. I can't bend down.

active: Hey! Wrench in hand, back off!
injured: Don't you dare. I'm still healing!

active: Ow! Okay. Okay. Get a kit.
injured: I can't... I can't feel my fingers.

active: Not a scratch. I'm almost proud.
Good. I can go to lunch.
injured: Back in one piece. One of us is.
Fine. Good. I'll sit down now.

active: Do you know what parts cost?
injured: Don't make me fix it like this.

active: Grade's nice. The repair bill is nicer.
injured: Grade's fine. My insurance is not.
Let's count what's broken. Including me.

active: I'll fix the drone. Who fixes me?
Two jobs off. Don't break anything.

memorial: Dot, mechanic. Kept every drone flying, and complained the whole time.

active: She'll get there. Go easy on the battery.
Look at them all coming home. I'm going to be up all night fixing them.

active.text: Props are spinning. Nothing rattled. Good.
Up it goes. Treat it nice.
Liftoff. I can hear every bearing.

injured.text: Up you go. I can't climb after it today.
Liftoff. Sounds fine. Keep it fine.

active.text: Don't scrape my props!
That was nearly a repair bill.
Keep a gap. Paint isn't free.

injured.text: Close! I can't fix much with one hand.
Easy. Don't give me more work.

active.text: Sand in the motors. Lovely.
Low enough to pick up grit. Stop it.
I'll be cleaning that filter tonight.

injured.text: Low. Grit. My poor motors.
Please don't eat the ground.

active.text: Listen to those motors scream.
That's all she's got. Don't ask for more.
Top speed. Watch your temps.

injured.text: Flat out. Don't cook the motors.
That's my tune-up. Enjoy it.

active.text: Battery's at a quarter. Ugh.
Low battery. I'm not carrying it home.
You're draining it. Land before it sags.

injured.text: Low battery. I can't run out for it today.
Quarter left. Come home.

active.text: No! My props!
That's coming out of your pay.
I heard that from the van.

injured.text: Great. Now we're both broken.
I felt that in my stitches.

active.text: Reset. Battery's topped, don't waste it.
Fresh pack in. Try not to bend it.
Back to the start. I checked it over.

injured.text: Reset. One-handed pack swap. You're welcome.
Fresh battery. Be nice to it.

active.text: Weather's turning. Wet motors, here we go.
Feel that? The air's heavier.
New weather. Watch the battery.

injured.text: Weather's changing. My stitches itch.
Air's turning. Mind the pack.

active.text: Hovering burns battery too, you know.
Motors sound bored.
Going somewhere, or just humming?

injured.text: Nice and steady. I like steady.
Just hovering. Fine by me.

active.text: Dot on the radio. Don't break anything on your day off.
Fresh pack, free sky. Bring it back in one piece.
I'm listening to the motors. Go have fun.

injured.text: Dot here. One hand on the wrench, one on the radio.
Fly gentle. I can't fix much right now.

active.text: There. And nothing fell off.
Made it. Motors sound fine.
Good. That's a landing I like.

injured.text: Made it. Good, less work for me.
There. Nice and gentle.
